channel.title: IndieHOT — Indie Game Hot Topics
channel.description: IndieHOT collects indie game news from a set of public sources every day and scores it by rules: engines & tools, publishing & marketing, devlogs, industry & funding, events, reviews & postmortems. Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are shown — no full text is republished.

item.title: Engineering 60FPS Multiplayer Browser Games with HTML5 Canvas & WebSockets (Ludo, Stickman & Clicker)
item.description: The author breaks down how zero-install browser multiplayer games use client prediction and deterministic state machines to lock 60fps, a useful reference for indies wanting lightweight web multiplayer.

item.title: Make 100 NPCs for your game in 5 minutes
item.description: The author used the in-house tool MOLD to batch-generate stylistically consistent low-poly characters in one click, exporting GLB files ready for Godot and Unity.

item.title: Kuudu: Breathe a Vesak Lantern Home with Your Breath
item.description: A relaxing rhythm game controlled by breathing, where players guide a glowing paper lantern forward, showing the gameplay potential of alternative input methods.

item.title: Your game backlog is not a to-do list. Stop treating it like one.
item.description: Data from 129 real backlogs shows 84% of games stay forever in the 'to-do' pile, and the list really works as a menu, a memo, and a wishlist rather than a task queue waiting to be cleared.

item.title: Wallhammer Web: building destruction in my TypeScript and WebGL2 engine
item.description: A developer shares building destruction tests in a self-built browser engine: demolishing walls and load-bearing structures makes buildings collapse, all in TypeScript with raw WebGL2.

item.title: A Game Startup Guide for Artists Who Stayed Home: How to Run a Studio Without a Huge Hit
item.description: A translated GDC 2023 talk: Norwegian visual artist Yngvill Hopen shares how a studio can keep running without a breakout hit.

item.title:

item.description: An indie horror game built in Godot, whose first chapter drops players into a mysterious cabin on an Arctic Christmas Eve, a useful reference for small-scale narrative horror atmosphere.

item.title: Why "Optimized" GIFs Turn Into Haunted Sprite Sheets (And 4 Tiny Canvas Fixes for 2D Game Devs)
item.description: Feeding 'optimized' GIFs into a custom importer often misaligns sprite sheets, and this article breaks down the cause and offers four small Canvas fixes.

item.title: Checking a Four-Direction Sprite Sheet Before Importing It
item.description: Quickly check a four-direction walk cycle's frame count and facing before import, so characters do not walk wrong in-game.

item.title: Throwing Out the Widget Tree: Building a 2D Game Engine Underneath Flutter (Sting)
item.description: The author shares building the 2D game engine Sting from scratch under Flutter, focusing on large-scale unit simulation on hex grids.

item.title: On Fire! October Honor of Kings iOS Revenue 1.1 Billion Yuan, Shuaitu Zhibin Surges 90%, Wuthering Waves Up 57%
item.description: Sensor Tower's October chart shows top positions stable with clear mid-tier reshuffling, and Shuaitu Zhibin and Wuthering Waves revenues surging sharply.

item.title: October 2026 Press Scores Roundup
item.description: indienova rounds up last month's released games' press scores at the start of each month, listing each game's Metacritic score by platform, so developers can compare peer titles' reception.

item.title: I built a free 3D character creator and put it on itch.io
item.description: The free browser-based 3D character creator MOLD offers 12 character archetypes and exports for direct use in your own game projects.

item.title: What a gacha launch week taught me about building a bilingual fan wiki
item.description: The author replays building a bilingual fan wiki for a newly launched gacha mobile game, summarizing how to quickly answer new players' most common early-game questions.

item.title: 🔥 Welcome to FIREGAMES STUDIOS!
item.description: The new studio FIREGAMES STUDIOS debuted, developing the open-world life sim CityBound Simulator, worth watching for future devlogs.

item.title: How a Tombala Card Is Generated: Six Cards, Ninety Numbers
item.description: The author wrote a generator for the Tombalings game that uses numbers 1 to 90 exactly once each to produce six fair bingo cards, for developers interested in card generation algorithms.

item.title: ChuApp Big Industry News of the Week: Rings of the Void Second Beta Sign-Ups Open, Phantom Blade Zero Misses the Golden Joystick Grand Prize
item.description: A weekly industry roundup: Rings of the Void opens sign-ups for its second beta, Eggy Party shuts down its Bilibili channel server, and Phantom Blade Zero misses out on the Golden Joystick grand prize — a quick scan of the week's direction.

item.title: I built a Worms-like mobile game alone: 48 tanks, destructible terrain, and the parts that actually took the time
item.description: A solo dev shipped a turn-based artillery mobile game on one Flutter codebase and explains where the time really went: making every shot readable before adding any content.

item.title: We did the math on Fortnite's rarest drop — 1 in 137,500
item.description: Epic published the drop rate for the Treasure Hunters event's most hunted item, Pirate Shop Access, at 1 in 137,500 chests, ending a two-week community debate.

item.title: Learn to Build Procedural Game Environments in Houdini
item.description: A four-hour workshop explains how to build stylized fantasy scenes with procedural workflows in Houdini, ZBrush, and Unreal Engine.
